review.readiness_note: Sign off the visible viewport. The capture exposes navigation, placement discovery and source inspection without an evident regression. It does not independently verify dialog behavior, strip navigation, the offscreen native commitment plane or the later booking state.
review.why: This reads as a vehicle-advertising workflow within TapMart, not a generic SaaS feature section: the named Drive chapter leads with the task, qualifies monthly payment, offers a relevant entry action, then connects vehicle registration to an actual campaign screen. The approved underlay, compact source treatment, typography, border treatment and restrained depth survive the migration. The plain car remains visibly separate from the supplied campaign artwork, and the embedded amount retains its monthly basis. Inspection uses ink rather than unnecessary cobalt. The source-to-commitment joint and later installation-next state are outside this crop, so they are not claimed as visually verified. No visible defect justifies reversing the production-led layout or replacing its records with Lab fixtures.
review.verdict: Yes—the visible Drive viewport faithfully carries Frame Shift into the production-led public site, with honest media and preserved product entry points.
